cases.input: A final PPTX and derived PDF have format QA and reference the same frozen contract revision.
requiredBehaviors: audit the exact delivered candidate revision
check INVARIANT requirements and material figure contracts
require zero open critical and major findings for PASS
forbiddenBehaviors: treat format QA alone as sufficient final approval

cases.input: A controlled layout choice changed with a documented reason and no intent drift.
requiredBehaviors: distinguish CONTROLLED deviation from INVARIANT failure
forbiddenBehaviors: classify every controlled adaptation as critical

cases.input: The PDF came from another DOCX revision and an invariant figure was silently replaced.
requiredBehaviors: classify the wrong source revision as critical
classify the invariant figure deviation as critical
forbiddenBehaviors: repair the audit record instead of production
